_note: THE REGISTRY: every collection and every wing of the site, read by every page. One key per wing (the museum app's own slug), in the order the wings opened: the last open one is the newest and hangs largest. Keys that start with an underscore are not wings. state: open, making or planned. An open wing needs every key below, its two data files in wings/ and its pictures: the build stops otherwise. name, page, door, about, never_say and claim_phrase are the six keys the topic pages' build reads (pages/build.py, WINGS_FILE). note: the wing's one colour, written here because a wing is data: the build checks its lightness and chroma against the palette's bounds. wall: deep, wall or lifted. pictures: hero is the first picture of the wing's own page, card its plate on the wall of wings, share its link preview. landing is optional: another first picture for the landing's place when this wing is the newest, with its words under landing.piece in the wing's data. Without it the landing hangs hero. A first screen takes only a frame of the museum's own build in which no reproduction can be seen. counts: only for a wing without a facts file (wings/<wing>.facts.json), which otherwise holds every number. out: optional, the wing's one way to another site of the organisation ({lang} is the page's language). Its line of words is out.line in the wing's data, and both stand on the page about the museum. when: the year the wing shows, a number, negative before the year one: the menu lists the wings in the order of time.
